title: Egyptian, Israeli and Hamas Delegations Hold Cairo Talks to Save Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two
detail: Senior Israeli and Egyptian officials held talks in Cairo over July 9–11, 2026 on advancing the stalled second phase of the Gaza ceasefire agreement, coinciding with a separate Hamas delegation visit led by Khalil al-Hayya to meet Egyptian mediators. Hamas reaffirmed its readiness to hand over administrative control of Gaza to the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza, discussed a proposed Rafah buffer-zone arrangement, and addressed the disarmament formula demanded by Israel and mediators as a precondition for full Israeli military withdrawal. According to an Egyptian source cited by Asharq Al-Awsat, the Israeli delegation warned that if the revised draft proposals fail, Israel would move ahead with renewed military operations inside Gaza. The talks — held alongside continued Egypt-Qatar-Turkey mediation efforts — underscored persistent disagreement over Hamas disarmament, the timeline for Israeli withdrawal, and post-war governance and security arrangements in Gaza.

media.caption: Egyptian, Israeli, and Hamas delegations hold talks in Cairo to salvage Gaza ceasefire phase-two implementation
